confidence: low: only 2 sources and no fan vote or poll (Ranker unreachable, YouGov Disney page not found, search budget exhausted). Both are critic-weighted, which favors classics and Zootopia over crowd favorites (Lion King 8th, Frozen 16th). The 2016 Smart Rating predates Moana, Encanto, Raya, Zootopia 2, Frozen II, so those were scored 38 for it; using RT alone they would sit Moana 6th, Raya 11th, Encanto 12th, Zootopia 2 15th. Treat Moana/Encanto placement as understated. Recommend adding a fan source before using.
